title: Weekly 2026-09-20 — Conveyor seal-in and stop interlocks
goal: Read a Japanese-labelled conveyor start latch, stop button, photoeye and overload protection.

rubric.must: The start and auxiliary contacts form a visible parallel seal-in branch.
Stop, photoeye and overload contacts precede the motor coil.
